technology_name: Autonomous AI-Powered Drone for Disaster Response & Search Operations
problem_solved: Delayed response times, high risks to human rescuers, and the total inability to navigate or locate survivors in GPS-denied, hazard-choked disaster zones.
description: An AI-powered autonomous UAV system engineered for search and rescue (SAR) operations in challenging terrains (floods, earthquakes, landslides). The drone integrates advanced computer vision (YOLO/CNN) for real-time human and thermal anomaly detection with edge-computed LiDAR and SLAM technologies for autonomous flight in indoor or GPS-denied zones. It includes a physical mechanism to drop survival payloads (first-aid, food) and supports swarm coordination.
applications:
• Emergency response and search & rescue (SAR) for NDRF, state SDRFs, and military units

• Post-disaster structural damage assessment for municipal bodies and insurance firms

• Autonomous medical and emergency supply delivery to isolated terrain

• High-resolution topological mapping and boundary security for forestry and defense
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
